claim.claim-text: a receiving section (203) configured to receive a beam failure detection reference signal (BFD-RS); and a control section (401) configured to, when detecting beam failure by part of BFD-RSs among configured BFD-RSs, control to transmit, on an uplink shared channel, a medium access control control element (MAC CE), including an index related to a candidate beam for use in new communication and information indicating a cell in which the candidate beam is detected, to recover from the beam failure, and wherein a size of the MAC CE is 2 or more octets.
2. A radio communication method for a terminal (20), comprising:

receiving a beam failure detection reference signal (BFD-RS); and when detecting beam failure by part of BFD-RSs among configured BFD-RSs, controlling to transmit, on an uplink shared channel, a medium access control control element (MAC CE), including an index related to a candidate beam for use in new communication and information indicating a cell in which the candidate beam is detected, to recover from the beam failure, and wherein a size of the MAC CE is 2 or more octets.
3. A system (1) comprising a terminal (20) and a base station (10), wherein

the terminal (20) comprises: a receiving section (203) configured to receive a beam failure detection reference signal (BFD-RS); and a control section (401) configured to, when detecting beam failure by part of BFD-RSs among configured BFD-RSs, controls to transmit, on an uplink shared channel, a medium access control control element (MAC CE), including an index related to a candidate beam for use in new communication and information indicating a cell in which the candidate beam is detected, to recover from the beam failure, and
the base station (10) comprises: a receiving section (103) configured to receive the MAC CE, and wherein a size of the MAC CE is 2 or more octets.
